title: Grateful Dead Live at Dream Bowl on 1969-02-21
lineage: Dat (Sony R500) -> Tascam SS-R05 -> Adobe Audition v3.0 -> Samplitude Professional v11.2 -> FLAC

ai_review.summary: A crisp soundboard upgrade captures a transcendent early‑69 show highlighted by an epic The Eleven and soaring Dark Star.
ai_review.review: The new Charlie Miller mastering clears up the old muddiness, delivering bright, relatively clean sound despite some tape hiss. Musically the concert is hailed as one of the band’s finest of the era – The Eleven erupts for twenty minutes, Dark Star soars, Lovelight transitions flawlessly and a stunning Morning Dew closes the night.

ai_rating.rationale: The vast majority of reviews are 5‑star praising both performance (especially The Eleven, Dark Star and Lovelight) and improved sound quality; a single 3‑star note about hiss lowers the average only slightly.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Crisp, bright mix with much less muddiness than earlier releases. Noticeable tape hiss remains and a few minor anomalies, but overall the sound is clean and well‑balanced.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Strong, flowing set – the first half builds into a flawless Lovelight transition, followed by an epic The Eleven and a fiery Dark Star that culminates in a beautiful Morning Dew encore.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Praised for blistering speed, precision and fluidity on The Eleven; some reviewers note a brief pause early in the song but overall his playing is described as transcendent.
band_member_comments.Phil: Described as "fired up" and highlighted for his enthusiastic intro to Lovelight.
band_member_comments.Drums: Crazy, inspired drumming noted especially during The Eleven and the Dark Star outro.
